experiment_data.hypothesis: Significance-based ASV (v2 logic: min delta where |plim tau| < z_crit*SE) controls Type I error when used as hypothesis test filter, because under H0 the plim starts at tau_true=0 at delta=0, immediately non-significant, giving ASV=0 < 1 which blocks rejection. Magnitude ASV failed because tau=0 returns None which passed the filter.
